prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape editorial cover for a TaraHome article, blog library card, Open Graph image, and Twitter image. Create one polished editorial photograph that communicates Apple Home continuing basic local smart-home control during an internet outage. Show a warm contemporary residential living room in early evening, with natural oak, linen, softly textured plaster, and restrained dark-forest-green accents. Ordinary room lamps remain warmly illuminated. On a low console in the midground, include a small unbranded home router with one subtle amber WAN-status light, a compact unbranded white fabric smart speaker, and a low unbranded black media box placed naturally among books and a ceramic object. A homeowner at the edge of the frame is calmly using a normal physical wall light switch, showing that the home itself still works. No phone or computer screen is visible. Use a wide horizontal 3:2 composition, with the important room, switch action, and small hub devices kept in the central crop-safe area so both a 16:10 article hero crop and a 16:9 blog-card crop remain coherent. The story must read at thumbnail size, with natural photographic depth and believable device scale. Use warm practical lamp light with soft cool daylight at a distant window, calm and reassuring rather than dramatic, premium residential editorial photography, natural materials, and mild lived-in imperfection. Devices must be generic and unbranded, with no logos, trademarks, Apple marks, fake labels, or product text. No embedded title, headline, letters, numbers, captions, watermark, UI, screens, charts, diagrams, icons, routing lines, network paths, glowing connection trails, decorative overlays, translucent panels, inset frames, split screens, floating cards, progress bars, or sci-fi visual effects. Do not create an infographic or an AI-looking smart-home diagram. Do not put a conspicuous red error symbol anywhere.
